route.create3d.summary: Numerically solve a 3D centerline through waypoints with end tangents and a transport frame; report arc length, min bend radius, self-contact and clearances.

inputs.waypoints: Array of at least two [x,y,z] length-expression waypoints.
inputs.interpolation: spline (default, Catmull-Rom through all waypoints) or polyline.
inputs.endTangents: Optional {start:[dx,dy,dz],end:[dx,dy,dz]} requested end tangents; reported against the computed tangent.
inputs.up: Transport-frame up direction, default [0,0,1]; stable through inflections.
inputs.normalSections: Optional array of {station:length} stations for normal-section reports.
inputs.section: Optional native profile ref for a sweep (existing shape.route path mode; not generated here).
inputs.representation: recipe (default); native persistent 3D path is a declared gap.

limitations: No unstable Frenet frame; bend radius is the local circumradius of sample triples and inflections are handled. AWG does not define insulation diameter; declare the section/envelope explicitly.
Endpoints alone do not define a flexible route; waypoints/constraints are explicit. Native 3D sweep generation reuses shape.route existing-path mode and is not created here.

route.inspect.summary: Inspect a route from waypoints or an explicit centerline: arc length, min neutral-axis bend radius, transport frames, self-contact and clearances.

inputs.centerline: Explicit array of [x,y,z] sample points (exclusive with waypoints).
inputs.interpolation: spline (default) or polyline when waypoints are supplied.

limitations: Bend radius is numerically sampled, not an analytic exactness guarantee; the centerline is a recipe/numerical model, not a native parametric path.

route.cut-list.summary: Compute cut lengths under the explicit interpretation cutLength = L * allowanceFactor + 2 * serviceTail (1.1*L + 2*15 mm default), never double-adding a modeled tail.

inputs.serviceTail: Nonnegative per-end service tail length, default 15 mm.
inputs.serviceTailModeled: Boolean, default false; true means the tail is already in L and is not added again.

limitations: Cut length is a declared interpretation, not a durability or cycle-life claim. Service tail is added exactly once; set serviceTailModeled:true when it is already modeled.

route.motion-states.summary: Report route state at the cartesian product of PAN/TILT extremes, preserving neutral-axis length and classifying each state as set, numerically-solved or native-dependent.

inputs.length: Positive neutral-axis length L, preserved across every pose.
inputs.poses: Explicit array of {pan,tilt,bendRadius?} poses (exclusive with pan/tilt ranges).
inputs.minBendRadius: Optional declared tightest bend radius the route can achieve.

limitations: The PAN x TILT product is evaluated at extremes, not a synchronous diagonal track. Required bend radius is a numerical upper-bound model of the swept articulation; no cycle-life or durability claim is made without a cycle test.
